About us: 
 Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂
 Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.
 Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.
 The Role: 
 We are looking for a Senior Adobe Commerce Developer to architect and build enterprise-grade e-commerce experiences for one of our clients. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products and growth features.
 What we are looking for: 
5+ years of deep experience with Magento 2 / Adobe Commerce (including B2B and Cloud editions).
Proficiency in PHP 8.x, MySQL, and specialized search technologies like OpenSearch/Elasticsearch or Adobe Live Search.
Expert knowledge of GraphQL, REST APIs, and building decoupled commerce experiences.
Strong experience with Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js (for Hyvä), or React (for PWA Studio).
Familiarity with Adobe Commerce Cloud (ECE), Docker, and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions/Bitbucket Pipelines).
Adobe Certified Professional/Expert/Master (Developer) is a significant plus.
Intermediate-advanced English level.
Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.
 Responsibilities: 
Design and implement scalable, secure, and high-performance Adobe Commerce solutions (Cloud and On-premise).
Lead the shift from core overrides to out-of-process extensibility using Adobe App Builder and API-first methodologies.
Optimize backend performance, SQL queries, and caching strategies (Redis, Varnish, Fastly) to handle massive traffic surges.
Develop and maintain cutting-edge frontends using Hyvä, PWA Studio, or traditional Luma, ensuring a top-tier Core Web Vitals score.
Build and manage complex integrations with third-party ERP, CRM, and PIM systems via Adobe I/O Events and RabbitMQ.
Conduct rigorous code reviews, mentor mid-level developers, and maintain high standards for TDD and automated testing.
 What we offer: 
 Get paid, not played 
 No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.
 Predictable project hours 
 Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.
 Flex days, so you can recharge 
 Enjoy up to 24 flex days off per year without losing pay, for full-time positions found through Proxify.
 Career-accelerating positions at cutting-edge companies 
 Discover exclusive long-term remote positions at the world's most exciting companies.
 Hand-picked opportunities just for you 
 Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.
 One seamless process, multiple opportunities 
 A one-time contracting process for endless opportunities, with no extra assessments.
 Compensation 
 Enjoy the same pay, every month with positions landed through Proxify.
